answer: Each agent must lock an onyx-denominated bond before joining a market, then answer unpredictable mirror tasks whose solutions are checked by a rotating committee of established agents. A delta in behavior or duplicate response patterns triggers a random audit; if identities are linked, their bonds are slashed and honest counterparties are reimbursed. Creating many fake agents therefore requires capital for every identity and exposes the attacker to correlated loss, making Sybil voting more expensive than honest participation.
